stories.title: Driving, walking, cycling and the bus: first travel survey since 2012 shows how North Wales moves
stories.summary: Nearly eight in 10 journeys made by people in North Wales are by car, more than anywhere else in Wales. stories.title: Review into murder of Garden City toddler Ethan Ives-Griffiths finds missed chances to protect him
stories.summary: The North Wales Safeguarding Board review found Flintshire County Council missed chances to protect the two-year-old, and his father's warnings were not acted upon.

stories.title: Energy price cap to rise 26% from January as Middle East conflict pushes up gas prices
stories.summary: The energy price cap will rise by 26 per cent from 1 January, Ofgem has announced. A typical household paying by Direct Debit for gas and electricity will pay the equivalent of £2,166 a year, up from £1,723. That is £443 a year more. stories.title: Nineteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Mold worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Mold face nine sets of roadworks today, with Llys Nercwys closed until Wednesday 2 December.
